name: Decentralism

subjectOf.text: Decentralization is the antidote to the failures of both socialism and capitalism: centralized coordination of societal and economic activity, in whichever ideological form, should be held to a minimum in order to free human potential and improve society.
subjectOf.abstract: Decentraliszation posits that centralized coordination of societal and economic activity, as instituted and instantiated in capitalistic or socialistic doctrine, should be held to a minimum in order to free the human potential and improve society.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Blockchain Technology for Good (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3709041

subjectOf.text: Decentralism, unlike capitalism and socialism, does not resolve who owns assets but rather calls the concept of ownership itself into question and reorients the question toward the largest possible utility of assets for humankind.
subjectOf.abstract: decentralism calls the concept of ownership into question and focuses on the largest possible utility of assets for human kind.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Blockchain Technology for Good (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3709041

subjectOf.text: Decentralism generates efficiency through higher levels of connectivity rather than through the linear cost cutting and economies of scale that capitalism and socialism debate.
subjectOf.abstract: decentralism creates efficiency not in linear forms but via higher levels of connectivity
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Blockchain Technology for Good (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3709041

subjectOf.text: Decentralism produces greater equality not through markets or governmental redistribution but through preserving diversity of content, diversity of data sources, and enhanced node connectivity.
subjectOf.abstract: decentralism creates higher levels of equality in society through the preservation of diversity of content, diversity of data sources, and enhanced node connectivity
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Blockchain Technology for Good (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3709041

subjectOf.text: Redistribution in decentralism is grounded in ownership rights in each person's individuality derived data that creates economic value, rather than in taxation or market determined income.
subjectOf.abstract: decentralism's redistribution is based on ownership rights in persons' individuality-derived data that creates economic value.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Blockchain Technology for Good (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3709041

subjectOf.text: Because decentralism pursues growth through connectivity and network effects rather than per unit cost reduction and economies of scale, negative externalities are minimized without any centralized planning.
subjectOf.abstract: As such, negative externalities are minimized without centralized planning.
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Blockchain Technology for Good (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3709041
